what: Clicking a same-site link fills a background-colored curtain from the bottom of the screen upward over 1s while the current page is pushed up 50vh, and when the curtain is full the page changes. On the new page the curtain peels away from bottom to top, using its top edge as the axis, while the content rises from 50vh below into place at the same time (both power2.inOut) — a transition that covers from below and uncovers upward.

options.dur: Cover fill and lift duration (seconds), default 1 — at 0 it moves on directly with no cover
options.shift: Distance the body text is pushed, default 50vh
options.ease: Curve (GSAP name or 0.65,0,0.35,1 form), default power2.inOut
options.reveal: Duration (s) for the curtain to clear on the incoming page, default same as dur
options.reveal-ease: Retract curve, same as the default ease
options.delay: Pause before clearing on the incoming page (s), default 0

note: The curtain attaches to the body (stays fixed on screen even when the content moves). Just before leaving, fx:leave fires from the body — used to close the menu drawer. The arrived flag lives in sessionStorage, so opening fresh or reloading shows the page immediately without the curtain
